text:
Beijing has tightened scrutiny of quantitative trading funds in recent months amid fears they add to market instability. Yet a leading investor believes the future is bright for China’s quant funds, as they are “necessary for a developed economy”.
Seth Huang, the head of Aris Capital, said quant funds had such a clear advantage over retail investors on China

近几个月来，北京加强了对量化交易基金的审查，担心它们加剧市场不稳定。然而，一位知名投资者认为中国量化基金的未来是光明的，因为它们“对发达经济体来说是必要的”。
Aris Capital负责人黄晟表示，量化基金在中国相对于散户投资者具有如此明显的优势
